title: Horcrux vs Deathly Hallow
script: This is a Horcrux. This is a Deathly Hallow. So what's the difference? Most people think they're just powerful magical artifacts created for immortality. They're not. A Horcrux tears a dark wizard's soul apart out of cowardice to cheat death. A Deathly Hallow is an ancient legendary item designed to master death through supreme magic and acceptance. That's why a Horcrux destroys your humanity, while a Hallow makes you the master of death. Follow for more.
